title: Improving Conversational Recommendation Systems via Counterfactual Data Simulation

problem.claim: Conversational recommender systems aim to provide recommendation services through natural language conversations.

gap.claim: Existing conversational recommender systems often suffer from insufficient training because recommendation-oriented dialogue datasets are scarce and difficult to annotate.

narrative_sequence.summary: Conversational recommender systems provide recommendation services through natural language conversations.
Prior approaches for developing capable conversational recommender systems typically depend on sufficient training data.
Difficulty annotating recommendation-oriented dialogue datasets creates training-data scarcity and insufficient training.
